before: A turned top-level shape or line, and a shape with no width and no height, have no graphic projection and paint a placeholder.
after: Turned shapes paint turned about their extent centre and select by their painted geometry; a shape with no extent paints nothing and stays selectable. Source XML, including rot and flips, is unchanged.
reason: Only graphic projection, hit testing, and the selection frame change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
